'''Vanadium''' was a chemical element. [[Color/Legends|Colored]] silvery-gray, it was a hard transition metal with a ductile and malleable quality.<ref name="CW">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>
